## How this works

1. Replace `example text` in the **title** above with anything you like. Letters, spaces and basic punctuation (up to about 55 characters).
2. Click **Submit new issue**.
3. A GitHub Action runs the model and **the animation at the top of the profile changes to show the answer**. The bot also replies here and closes this issue (about a minute).

You can leave this box as is. Only the title is read.
